pairs: In diebus illis non erat rex in Israël,
In those days, there was no king in Israel.
et tribus Dan quærebat possessionem sibi,
And the tribe of Dan sought a possession for themselves,
so that they might live in it.
usque ad illum enim diem inter ceteras tribus sortem non acceperat.
For even to that day, they had not received their lot among the other tribes.
Miserunt ergo filii Dan stirpis et familiæ suæ quinque viros fortissimos de Saraa et Esthaol,
Therefore, the sons of Dan sent five very strong men, of their stock and family,
ut explorarent terram, et diligenter inspicerent:
from Zorah and Eshtaol, so that they might explore the land and diligently inspect it.
Qui cum pergentes venissent in montem Ephraim,
And after traveling, they arrived at mount Ephraim,
and they entered into the house of Micah.
And they recognized the speech of the youth who was a Levite.
And while making use of an inn with him,
quam ob causam huc venire voluisti?
For what reason did you want to come here?”
Hæc et hæc præstitit mihi Michas,
“Micah has offered me one thing and another,
and he has paid me wages,
so that I may be his priest.”
Rogaverunt autem eum ut consuleret Dominum ut scire possent an prospero itinere pergerent,
Then they begged him to consult the Lord, so that they might be able to know whether the journey they undertook would be prosperous,
and whether the matter would have success.
The Lord looks with favor on your path,
and on the journey that you have undertaken.”
Euntes igitur quinque viri venerunt Lais:
And so the five men, going on, arrived at Laish.
videruntque populum habitantem in ea absque ullo timore,
And they saw the people, living in it without any fear,
according to the custom of the Sidonians,
having hardly anyone to oppose them,
et procul a Sidone atque a cunctis hominibus separatum.
and living separately, far from Sidon and from all men.
Reversique ad fratres suos in Saraa
And they returned to their brothers at Zorah and Eshtaol,
who questioned them as to what they had done.
vidimus enim terram valde opulentam et uberem. Nolite negligere,
For we have seen that the land is very wealthy and fruitful. Do not delay;
Let us go out and possess it.
We shall enter to those who dwell securely,
and the Lord will deliver the place to us,
in quo nullius rei est penuria eorum quæ gignuntur in terra.
a place in which there is no lack of anything that grows upon the earth.”
Profecti igitur sunt de cognatione Dan,
those of the kindred of Dan set out,
six hundred men from Zorah and Eshtaol,
girded with the weapons of warfare.
And going up, they stayed at Kiriath-jearim of Judah.
qui locus ex eo tempore Castrorum Dan nomen accepit,
And so the place, from that time, received the name the Camp of Dan,
and it is behind the back of Kiriath-jearim.
From there, they crossed over to mount Ephraim.
And when they had arrived at the house of Micah,
qui prius missi fuerant ad considerandam terram Lais,
who before had been sent to consider the land of Laish,
said to the rest of their brothers:
Nostis quod in domibus istis sit ephod,
“You know that in these houses there is an ephod
Consider what it may please you to do.”
And when they had turned aside a little,
they entered the house of the Levite youth,
who was in the house of Micah.
And they greeted him with peaceful words.
Sexcenti autem viri ita ut erant armati,
Now the six hundred men, who were all armed,
At illi, qui ingressi fuerant domum juvenis, sculptile,
But those who had entered the house of the youth strove to take away the graven image,
atque conflatile tollere nitebantur, et sacerdos stabat ante ostium,
and the molten idol. But the priest was standing in front of the door,
sexcentis viris fortissimis haud procul expectantibus.
with the six hundred very strong men waiting not far away.
And so, those who had entered took away the graven image,
and the theraphim, and the molten idol.
And the priest said to them,
Tace et pone digitum super os tuum:
“Be silent and place your finger over your mouth.
ut habeamus te patrem, ac sacerdotem.
so that we may have you as a father as well as a priest.
For which is better for you:
ut sis sacerdos in domo unius viri,
to be a priest in the house of one man,
an in una tribu et familia in Israël?
or in one tribe and family in Israel?”
And when he had heard this,
and he set out with them.
et ante se ire fecissent parvulos
they had also sent the children,
and all that was valuable to go ahead of them.
et jam a domo Michæ essent procul,
And when they were far from the house of Micah,
viri qui habitabant in ædibus Michæ conclamantes secuti sunt,
the men who were living in the houses of Micah, crying out together, followed them.
And they began to shout behind their backs.
And when they had looked back,
which I made for myself, and the priest,
And the sons of Dan said to him,
Cave ne ultra loquaris ad nos,
“Take care that you no longer speak to us,
et veniant ad te viri animo concitati,
otherwise men with a mind for violence may overwhelm you,
et ipse cum omni domo tua pereas.
and you yourself would perish with all your house.”
And so, they continued on the journey that they had begun.
Videns autem Michas quod fortiores se essent,
But Micah, seeing that they were stronger than he was,
Now the six hundred men took the priest,
and the things we stated above,
veneruntque in Lais ad populum quiescentem
to a people quiet and secure,
et percusserunt eos in ore gladii:
and they struck them down with the edge of the sword.
And they burned the city with fire.
For no one at all sent reinforcements,
eo quod procul habitarent a Sidone,
because they lived far away from Sidon,
et cum nullo hominum haberent quidquam societatis
and they had no association or business with any man.
Now the city was situated in the region of Rehob.
Erat autem civitas sita in regione Rohob:
quam rursum exstruentes habitaverunt in ea,
calling the name of the city Dan,
according to the name of their father,
who had been born of Israel,
though before it was called Laish.
Posueruntque sibi sculptile, et Jonathan filium Gersam filii Moysi ac filios ejus sacerdotes in tribu Dan, usque ad diem captivitatis suæ.
And they established for themselves the graven image. And Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, with his sons, were priests in the tribe of Dan, even until the day of their captivity.
Mansitque apud eos idolum Michæ omni tempore quo fuit domus Dei in Silo.
And the idol of Micah remained with them during the entire time that the house of God was in Shiloh.
In diebus illis non erat rex in Israël.
In those days, there was no king in Israel.
